parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Integrate $\to \frac{x^{3/2}}{3/2}+2\frac{x^{1/2}}{1/2}\ (+C)$. — B1 B1. Guidance: B1 for each term correct – allow unsimplified. C not required. $\left[\frac{x^{3/2}}{3/2}+2\frac{x^{1/2}}{1/2}\right]_1^4\to \frac{40}{3}-\frac{14}{3}$. — M1. Guidance: Evidence of 4 and 1 used correctly in their integrand, i.e. at least one power increased by 1. $=\frac{26}{3}$ oe. — A1. Guidance: Allow 8.67 awrt. No integrand implies use of integration function on calculator 0/4. Beware a correct answer from wrong working. Total 4.
